captions.detailed: A short-travel dropper seatpost with an adjustable inner tube that slides vertically inside a slim black outer sleeve. The top of the inner tube features a dual-bolt saddle clamp holding a standard, ergonomically shaped black bicycle saddle with metallic rails. This adjustable height mechanism is modeled as a prismatic joint allowing up to 60 mm of travel.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of a short-travel bicycle dropper seatpost with a 60 mm travel prismatic joint. The assembly should feature a slim outer sleeve, an inner sliding tube, a universal 2-bolt saddle clamp, and an ergonomic black saddle held by metal rails.
captions.factory: The code constructs a base outer sleeve using a cylinder and adds a cable actuator mechanism at the bottom. It then models the inner sliding tube using a narrower cylinder. The saddle clamp is built from a combination of boxes and cylinders representing the lower and upper clamps, bolts, and saddle rails. Finally, the ergonomic saddle is generated by sweeping a custom profile or lofting cross-sections, and the inner tube is connected to the outer sleeve with a prismatic joint.
